module_boundaries.APIModule: Handles incoming HTTP requests and routes them to appropriate business logic.
module_boundaries.TODOModule: Implements CRUD operations for TODO items.
module_boundaries.ReminderModule: Schedules and sends email notifications based on reminders set.
module_boundaries.PersistenceLayer: Manages database interactions for storing data related to TODOs and reminders.

constraints: The auth/ module is frozen and should not be modified.
Integrate using the existing session middleware.
The API must support a load of 100 requests per second per instance, maintaining a stateless API tier.
Deploy the application to a single-region setup.
Do not use a message queue in this version.
acceptanceCriteria: Implementation of CRUD operations for TODO items via a REST API.
The system must trigger reminders and notify users within 60 seconds of the scheduled time during integration testing.
Load testing should demonstrate the system handling 100 requests per second for a duration of 60 seconds, maintaining a p99 latency of less than 200 milliseconds on the defined reference hardware.
